pages.text: Both guns use 16.5mm ammunition (qkl:16mm).$(br2)Prepare cores, wads, and powder before crafter assembly.$(br2)Powder has 3 refining tiers.
A Mechanical Saw cuts 1 Iron or Zinc Nugget into 10 Large Cores.$(br2)Use large cores, not ordinary cores or finished bullets.
Sequenced assembly: Start Paper, deploy Paper 3x, press, and saw.$(br2)Consumes 4 Paper and yields 30 Wads per cycle.
Crush Dripstone with wheels, then splash with a fan.$(br2)Yields purified Saltpeter for powder.
$(bold)Tier 1: Desperation$()$(br2)Craft 4 Bone Meal, 4 Charcoal, 1 Water in table.$(br)Smoke in Smoker or Campfire to yield 1 Powder Charge.
Mix 2 Saltpeter, 2 Coal, 250mB Water in Basin.$(br2)Press wet mass with Press to yield 4 Charges.
Mix 4 Saltpeter, 2 Coal, 1 Sulfur, 500mB Water in $(6)Heated Basin$().$(br2)Yields $(6)16 Charges$() (400% surge!).
Mined from Straja's mineral karst strata.$(br2)Catalyzes Tier 3 surges, ignites incendiary rounds, and feeds civilian chemical industries.
